source.title: Ludovic - Wreathed Eternalist
source.name: Ludovic
source.description: A reticent Support who heals allies and absorbs enemies' life force through everbloom flowers.

skills.name: Eternal Serenity

description.raw: Ludovic generates a field of everblooms with a total healing amount equal to 1200% of his current ATK at his position, restoring HP for adjacent allies by up to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) per second. Ludovic is unaffected while generating the everbloom field. The everbloom field will wither when its healing amount depletes but will restor 100% (ATK-based) per second and review when the healing amount is full. Active. Ludovic moves the everbloom field to a designated tile for it to release 3 healing waves, each restoring HP for all allies within 2 tiles by 110% (ATK-based). This takes effect even when the everbloom field is withered.
active: Ludovic generates a field of everblooms with a total healing amount equal to 1200% of his current ATK at his position, restoring HP for adjacent allies by up to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) per second.
Ludovic is unaffected while generating the everbloom field.
The everbloom field will wither when its healing amount depletes but will restor 100% (ATK-based) per second and review when the healing amount is full.
Ludovic moves the everbloom field to a designated tile for it to release 3 healing waves, each restoring HP for all allies within 2 tiles by 110% (ATK-based).
This takes effect even when the everbloom field is withered.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases the healing amount of each healing wave to 120% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases the healing amount of each healing wave to 130% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 171: Increases the healing amount of each healing wave to 140% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases the healing amount of each healing wave to 150% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Ludovic moves the everbloom field that releases healing waves to a designated tile to restore HP for allies within the range.

skills.name: Lifeweaver's Blooms

description.raw: Whenever a non-summoned enemy on the battlefield loses 40% (HP-based) of their HP, the everbloom field will absorb 15% (HP-based) of their max HP, up to 350% (ATK-based), as nutrients to restore its healing amount. Active. Ludovic hurls everblooms at the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt, making them lose HP equal to 40% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) per second over the next 4s.
active: Whenever a non-summoned enemy on the battlefield loses 40% (HP-based) of their HP, the everbloom field will absorb 15% (HP-based) of their max HP, up to 350% (ATK-based), as nutrients to restore its healing amount.
Ludovic hurls everblooms at the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt, making them lose HP equal to 40% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) per second over the next 4s.

text: Increases the target's lost HP per second to 45% (ATK-based) + 10 (SP-based).
Increases the target's lost HP per second to 50% (ATK-based) + 10 (SP-based).
Increases the target's lost HP per second to 55% (ATK-based) + 10 (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: The healing amount of the everbloom field will be restored when an enemy loses a certain amount of HP. Active. Ludovic deals damage to the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt and makes them lose HP.

skills.name: Ethereal Blooms

description.raw: Ludovic moves the everbloom field near the weakest ally and absorbs 9% + 1% (SP-based) of the nearest non-summoned enemy's HP, up to 250% (ATK-based), to restore the everbloom field's healing amount. herself
active: Ludovic moves the everbloom field near the weakest ally and absorbs 9% + 1% (SP-based) of the nearest non-summoned enemy's HP, up to 250% (ATK-based), to restore the everbloom field's healing amount.
herself

text: Increases the amount of absorbed HP to 10% + 1% (SP-based).
Increases the amount of absorbed HP to 11% + 1% (SP-based).
Increases the amount of absorbed HP to 12% + 1% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Ludovic moves the everbloom field to the designated ally's position and absorbs the HP of 1 nearby enemy to restore the everbloom field's healing amount.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Ludovic increases his Healing by 9 during battle. His Healing will increase by an extra 2 when the everbloom field accumulates a healing amount equal to 2400% (ATK-based).
active: Ludovic increases his Healing by 9 during battle.

skills.description_lite: Ludovic increases his Healing. His Healing will be further enhanced when the everbloom field accumulates a certain healing amount.

skills.name: Ephemeral Berries

description.raw: Every 2 times the everbloom field absorbs nutrients through Lifeweaver's Blooms, it will produce an Ephemeral Berry that explodes after a short delay, dealing 100% (ATK-based) damage to all enemies and restoring 130% (ATK-based) HP for all allies within range.

text: Increases damage dealt to 110% (ATK-based) and HP restored to 140% (ATK-based).
Permanently enhances the everbloom field upon the first 4 times it absorbs nutrients, restoring its healing amount by 50% (ATK-based) per second.
This takes effect even when the everbloom field is withered.
Increases damage dealt to 120% (ATK-based) and HP restored to 150% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Every few times the everbloom field absorbs nutrients through Lifeweaver's Blooms, it will produce a berry that explodes, dealing damage to enemies and healing allies within range.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Whenever an enemy steps into the everbloom field, they will instantly take 120% (ATK-based) damage and be stunned for 3s. This effect can be triggered once for each enemy every 12s.
active: Whenever an enemy steps into the everbloom field, they will instantly take 120% (ATK-based) damage and be stunned for 3s.
This effect can be triggered once for each enemy every 12s.
